logical_condition: Adult, nonpregnant patient; confirm according to the applicable BP measurement protocol
temporal_requirement: Use current/confirmed blood-pressure assessment; not a single unverified home or clinic value

logical_condition: Adult diabetes context; interpret albuminuria using the applicable laboratory and clinical confirmation framework
temporal_requirement: If used to identify persistent albuminuria, repeated measurements/confirmation are required; this rule alone does not diagnose CKD
Persistence/chronicity is required for CKD classification; a single low eGFR is not sufficient to establish chronicity

trigger: BNP_NTproBNP is above the assay-specific abnormal threshold
logical_condition: Asymptomatic adult with diabetes being evaluated for heart-failure risk
temporal_requirement: Current biomarker result; threshold is assay-specific and must not be hard-coded from a single universal cutoff
After an abnormal natriuretic peptide result, echocardiography is recommended by ADA to identify stage B heart failure
Current/previous established ASCVD event or diagnosis

trigger: T1D AND cardiac_or_associated_vascular_symptoms = true OR ECG_Abnormality = true
temporal_requirement: Current symptoms/finding; asymptomatic routine CAD screening is otherwise not recommended
